title: Sanaa's mass rally amid regional strikes: Houthis warn of escalation after death of Khamenei
summary: Amid regional strikes and reported death of Iran’s Supreme Leader, Sanaa in Yemen has emerged as a focal point of defiance. Yemen’s Houthi leader Abdul Malik al-Houthi declared support for Iran and said the group was ready to escalate militarily if necessary.
